C-TEST-TIME-BUDGET-2-3EC1F016.IntentSummary: Plan for `C-TEST-TIME-BUDGET-2-3EC1F016` (tier T3, roadmap `RM-GOVERNED-PATH`): eight tasks in two waves, each task carrying the narrowest instrument for its own subject, with the single full CI-equivalent verification left to `TargetAssertions` / `--assertions final`. Wave 1: T-001 (narrow the `validate:ci` duplicate-pass removal and guard it), T-002 (memoize the predecessor map with revision-token invalidation), T-003 (the selective, non-gating developer-loop runner), T-004 (per-test metrics with the freshness relation), T-005 (in-process validator calls, spawns kept where the process boundary is the contract), T-006 (teach the `close-time only` rule in `ngrace-plan`, `ngrace-spec` and `ngrace-execute`, both trees, with the `TAUGHT_RULES` tokens). Wave 2: T-007 (re-measure the footprint the rule forces and move the pins and the `README.md` cell), T-008 (the coverage-integrity guard). **Narrowed this successor**: `validate:release` keeps its `validate:cli` and is untouched; the two release guards that assert it (`scripts/validate-marketplace.ts:336`–`338`, `scripts/release-checklist.ts:250`) stay green by non-edit and are **not** in scope. **Full-suite runs: three** — one `bun run validate:ci` in `TargetAssertions` under `--assertions final --run-commands`, and the two genuinely whole-suite `CloseEvidence` criteria (`AC-FEWER-PASSES`, `AC-COVERAGE-INTACT`). No task `Verification` runs the whole suite, and `--assertions target` is evaluated without `--run-commands`, so the full run is final-only. Every `AC-*` is close-bound, so no task carries a `Satisfies`; absence of `Satisfies` is not an error and there is no unmapped ordinary criterion to warn.

T-001.Title: Narrow `validate:ci` to one suite run and guard it

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `package.json`'s `validate:ci` drops `bun run validate:cli` (its 211 tests already run by `bun run test` in the same script) and `validate:determinism` drops its `bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts src/review/scorer.test.ts` prefix while keeping `bun run ./scripts/validate-determinism.ts`. `validate:release` keeps its `validate:cli` and is **not** touched. `.github/workflows/validate.yml`'s duplicate `Run determinism and corpus ratchet gate (D4)` step and `publish.yml`'s duplicate `CLI validation` step are removed. A narrowed guard in `scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts` asserts the aggregate script `validate:ci` contains the full suite (`bun run test`) and no other resolved-test command, resolves `bun run validate:cli` to its tests, does **not** assert that of `validate:release`, and asserts `validate:release` still contains `validate:cli`. `scripts/publish-workflow.test.ts` asserts the deduped publish composition (no `bun run validate:cli`) with its other positive gates intact. The guard is driven red on a re-introduced subset in `validate:ci` before it greens. `bun run ./scripts/validate-marketplace.ts` and the `validate:release` composition check in `bun run ./scripts/release-checklist.ts` both stay green.

T-002.Title: Memoize the predecessor map with revision-token invalidation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `buildPredecessorMap` (`src/gates/ledger.ts`) is computed at most once per resolved project root per process, validated by a revision token recomputed on each call — the sorted `(bundle name, spec/plan byte size, mtimeMs)` over the active and archive bundle directories. The cached value is handed back as a frozen, read-only view, so a caller mutating a returned view cannot corrupt it. A guard in `src/gates/core.test.ts` drives both directions: an unchanged tree does not rebuild the map; a bundle **added**, **removed**, **renamed**, and **edited in place** each invalidates and yields what a cold process yields. The guard is driven red at HEAD (no memo seam) before it greens. `collectProjectStatus` and `runReview` return identical results for the same tree.

T-003.Title: Add the selective developer-loop runner and its non-gating guard

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: New `scripts/test-affected.ts`, run as `bun run test:affected`, takes a base ref, reads the changed files from git, maps each to the test files that exercise it (path convention plus an explicit dependency table), prints the selection and its reasons, and runs only those. It is fail-safe: an unmapped changed source under `src/` or `scripts/`, an empty or unavailable diff, or a merge-base failure selects the full suite. `scripts/test-affected.test.ts` proves the selection and the fallback and proves the non-gating rule — `validate:ci` and `validate:release` contain `bun run test` and never `test:affected`, and no active or archived `CloseEvidence` invokes the runner. The guard is driven red at HEAD (the runner does not exist) before it greens.

T-004.Title: Emit per-test metrics with a freshness relation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: New `scripts/test-metrics.ts`, run as `bun run test:metrics`, executes the suite once with `--reporter=junit` and writes a committed `test-metrics.json` holding per test file the test count and total ms, every individual test's ms and file, a `schemaVersion` and the generation date, and **no hostname or machine identifier**. It writes a provisional, tree-derived artifact before the metered run so the freshness guard passes inside that run. `scripts/test-metrics.test.ts` asserts the freshness relation — every `*.test.ts` in the tree appears exactly once, the per-file counts sum to the recorded testcase count, the artifact has exactly the four declared keys — and that a planted slower test moves the ranking. The guard is driven red on a stale artifact (a test file added without regenerating) and green after regeneration.

T-005.Title: Move the validator's bulk calls in-process and bound the spawns

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The bulk of `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts`'s `runValidator` calls the validator's exported `main(argv, cwd)` in-process (`scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts`), capturing stdout/stderr through a writer seam, so no process is created; the real spawn is kept — and said so — where the contract under test is the process exit code or the CWD boundary. The file's test count does not fall and every assertion keeps its subject. A guard states the bounded spawn count so a later re-spawn is visible. The in-process path is discriminated (a planted violation returns non-zero) and at least one exit-code/CWD contract still runs through a real spawn. The capture is proven **isolated**: the seam is restored after every call and a second in-process call observes only its own output, so no buffer leaks between tests — driven, because a stale buffer satisfying a "stderr contains" assertion is a false green, and the seam is shared mutable state by construction.

T-006.Title: Teach the `close-time only` verification rule in both skill trees

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md` gains a `must_do` row carrying `narrowest instrument` (a task's `Verification` names the narrowest instrument for its subject; the whole suite is not a per-task command; a `TargetAssertions` `MustPassCommand` does not duplicate `final`). `skills/ngrace/ngrace-spec/SKILL.md`'s `acceptance_criteria_anchors` and `skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md`'s `execution_rules` carry `close-time only` (the full CI-equivalent verification runs at `--assertions final --run-commands`, and a whole-suite `CloseEvidence` belongs only on a criterion genuinely about the whole suite). The `TAUGHT_RULES` entries live in `scripts/check-teaching-surface.ts` and the fixture copies in `scripts/check-teaching-surface.test.ts`, so a later softening reddens; the canonical and packaged skill bodies stay byte-identical.

T-007.Title: Re-measure the forced footprint and move the pins and README cell

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: After T-006 lands the skill text, the footprint is re-measured with `skillTextLines()`; `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts`'s `total` and `totalBytes` assertions and the `README.md` `:304` cell are set to the measured values — the **relation** (the pins equal the footprint measured at HEAD after the rewrite), never a projected figure. `README.md`'s Development block gains `bun run test:affected` and `bun run test:metrics`. The canonical skills are mirrored byte-identically into `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/*`, and both mirror drift checks (`scripts/validate-marketplace.ts:261`–`277`, `scripts/skill-contracts.test.ts`'s `published skill mirrors`) stay green.

A guard in `scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts` reads every `*.test.ts` at HEAD and at base `2434fd467458e15c12414a74e37b09f9d71bdfd2` (`git show <base>:<path>`) and asserts no test file has fewer `it(`/`test(` occurrences than at base, so no removed duplicate was removed by editing its test body; it reddens on a dropped test, driven both ways. The only removed work is the three proven duplicates named in the spec (the `validate:ci` `validate:cli` invocation, the `validate:determinism` test prefix, the `validate.yml` D4 step).
